run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T08:56:37Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by a broken rollout of the checkout Deployment. At 2026-11-15T08:56:44Z a new ReplicaSet (checkout-d75b77f99) was created from a malformed container image reference, 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0'. The previous, working checkout ReplicaSet (checkout-5dccddf8bb, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) was scaled to 0 and its only pod was deleted at 08:56:47Z. The replacement pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 cannot start: container 'checkout' is waiting with reason InvalidImageName and the message "Failed to apply default image tag ... couldn't parse image name ... invalid reference format". As a result the checkout Service has zero ready endpoints and checkout stopped emitting spans from about 09:02 (5m window). On the frontend, only the checkout path errors: POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and the outgoing grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder client spans turn to STATUS_CODE_ERROR from ~08:59, together with new tcp.connect errors, while every other frontend operation stays at 0 errors. frontend-proxy then logged 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1 500 - via_upstream' from upstream 'frontend' and its ingress/egress error spans rose from ~5 per 15 minutes to ~378 per 15 minutes, which is what the alert reports. The frontend and frontend-proxy pods themselves are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, so the proxy is reporting a dependency failure, not a fault of its own.

claims.text: frontend-proxy ingress spans in STATUS_CODE_ERROR rose from 1.15 (08:40), 2.11 (08:45), 6.21 (08:50) and 5.17 (08:55) per 15-minute increase to 76.55 (09:00), 285.52 (09:05), 377.97 (09:10) and 257.37 (09:15), while its non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) ingress spans stayed in the same ~4,270-10,060 per 15-minute band. This is the error-rate surge behind the RequestErrorRate alert.

The same rise appears on both frontend-proxy operations: span_name 'ingress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR increased 79.66 -> 373.55 over the 1-hour windows sampled between 09:00 and 09:15, and span_name 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR increased 72.51 -> 364.39 over the same points, against STATUS_CODE_UNSET series of ~16,000-20,700.

In the 5-second frontend-proxy access-log window 09:05:00Z-09:05:05Z, the only 5xx responses logged were three 'POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1' 500 - via_upstream lines, each naming upstream 'frontend' (100.96.4.165) and client 'python-requests/2.32.5'; no other path returned 5xx in that sample.

The checkout Deployment's container image is the unique non-standard value 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0' (it contains an embedded newline before the tag); every other otel-demo Deployment uses ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-<component> or its documented image.

Ownership chain shows a configuration rollout: ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 was created at 2026-11-15T08:56:44Z with the malformed image and is owned by Deployment 'checkout'; the older ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 08:18:39Z, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) is scaled to 0 replicas, and its ready/available status is absent.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (owned by ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99, created 2026-11-15T08:56:54Z, scheduled to node i-01ae77f852632de24) is Pending with container 'checkout' not ready, restartCount 0, state waiting, reason InvalidImageName and message: Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": couldn't parse image name "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": invalid reference format. Pod condition Ready is False with reason ContainersNotReady.

Namespace events between 08:56:44Z and 09:02:08Z record the rollout and its failure: pod checkout-d75b77f99-5mcsx Scheduled 08:56:44Z, the previous pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq 'Killing'/'SuccessfulDelete' at 08:56:47Z, then repeated Warning InspectFailed (count 27) and Warning Failed 'Error: InvalidImageName' on checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68, plus SuccessfulCreate of hgc68 at 08:56:54Z and ScalingReplicaSet 'Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0'.

Deployment 'checkout' shows spec.replicas 1 but no availableReplicas and no readyReplicas, and the checkout Service endpoints object has an empty ready-address list with 100.96.4.211 listed only as a not-ready address; by contrast the 'frontend' and 'frontend-proxy' endpoints each have one ready address (100.96.4.149 and 100.96.4.165).

The checkout service stopped producing spans: its only series is STATUS_CODE_UNSET, whose 5-minute increase fell 1013.33 (09:00), 553.33 (09:01) and then read 0 from 09:02 onwards; no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series exists for checkout in this window.

frontend's error spans are confined to the checkout call path: POST /api/checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR goes 0 -> 39.30 (08:59) -> 373.68 (09:10) per 10-minute increase, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' STATUS_CODE_ERROR and the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR follow the same curve, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_UNSET falls to 0 by 09:10, and tcp.connect STATUS_CODE_ERROR appears at 11.71-20.00 per 10 minutes from 08:59. All other frontend operations (GET, GET /, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, their api routes, /api/products/{productId}, /api/recommendations, AdService/GetAds, CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, RecommendationService/ListRecommendations, dns.lookup) stayed at 0 STATUS_CODE_ERROR.

The frontend and frontend-proxy pods are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 (frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 created 08:18:40Z, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-t9gll created 08:18:39Z), and all other otel-demo Deployments show 1 desired / 1 available / 1 ready; checkout is the only Deployment without available and ready replicas.

A separate, pre-existing frontend-proxy error mode existed before the checkout change: its 15-minute ingress error increase was already 1.15-6.21 between 08:40 and 08:55, and its log at 08:55:31Z contains 'GET /api/products/9SIQT8TOJO HTTP/1.1 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}'. This low-volume baseline predates the 08:56:44 checkout ReplicaSet and does not account for the ~70x rise.

Primary cause: the checkout Deployment was updated at 08:56:44Z to the malformed image 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0'. The rolling update terminated the working checkout pod before any replacement could become ready, the new pod can never start (InvalidImageName), and checkout has had zero ready endpoints since 08:56:47Z. The frontend's gRPC PlaceOrder calls to checkout therefore fail (error client spans plus new tcp.connect errors) and its POST /api/checkout handler returns HTTP 500, which frontend-proxy passes upstream and records as ingress/egress error spans, driving the RequestErrorRate alert on frontend-proxy.

frontend-proxy itself is not the faulty component: its pod is Ready with 0 restarts, it still served ~10,000 non-error ingress spans per 15 minutes, and every observed 5xx it returned in the incident window was labelled with response flag 'via_upstream' toward upstream 'frontend', i.e. a response it received rather than a local failure.

Rejected: a cluster-wide or frontend-wide error event. The error-span series that existed for accounting, cart and payment read 0 throughout 08:45-09:16, ad, recommendation and fraud-detection stayed at their pre-existing ~1-2 per 15 minutes without a step change, and no frontend operation outside POST /api/checkout (and its api-route and PlaceOrder child spans) produced STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not loaded in this Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules returned no_data for both the rule-name filter and an unfiltered call), so the alert expression, its 'above 0' threshold, its for-duration and the meaning of annotation value 'current: 2.0444444444444443' could not be verified.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what set the checkout Deployment image to 'quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0' at 08:56:44Z, and whether it came from CI, a manual apply or a patch, is unknown.

Timing at sub-minute resolution is unresolved: the alert start 08:56:37Z precedes the new checkout ReplicaSet (08:56:44Z) and the deletion of the old checkout pod (08:56:47Z) by seconds, and the metric steps are 60s, so the exact instant the first checkout-caused proxy error occurred cannot be pinned from this data.

Jaeger data in this window ends at about 08:44:09Z (trace queries show data_as_of 08:44 and freshness ~2030s), so spans from the actual incident period (08:56-09:17) could not be inspected; searches for frontend error spans and for POST /api/checkout in 08:56-09:17 returned no_data, which is a coverage gap, not proof that no such spans exist.

The frontend container log stream returned no lines for 08:57:00Z-09:17:47Z, and frontend-proxy access-log lines after about 09:05:31Z were not readable (0 lines read for the 09:10 window), so the frontend's application-level gRPC error text and the full 5xx path coverage later in the incident are unverified.

rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count has no series in this window (get_label_values on service_name and get_series with rpc_service="checkout" both returned no_data), so the gRPC status code returned by the failing frontend->checkout PlaceOrder call could not be read from that metric.

The prior checkout pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq was deleted at 08:56:47Z before it could be inspected, so its last termination reason, exit code and pre-rollout health are unknown; whether the rollout was preceded by any earlier instability on checkout cannot be confirmed.

Error-span series were returned only for accounting, ad, cart, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment and recommendation; currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, shipping, kafka, load-generator and otel-collector had no returned series, so their health during the window is unknown rather than proven clean.
next_steps: Recommend reverting the checkout Deployment container image to the working value ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout and confirming a new ReplicaSet rolls out with a Ready pod, then verifying the checkout Service endpoints and frontend POST /api/checkout responses recover.

Recommend adding admission or CI validation that rejects container image references with whitespace/newlines or unparsable references, so an InvalidImageName rollout cannot take the only checkout replica out of service.

Recommend considering a readiness/availability alert on the checkout Deployment or Service endpoints (0 ready addresses) so a broken rollout surfaces directly rather than only through the frontend-proxy error rate.

Advisory: inspect Alertmanager configuration and the RequestErrorRate rule expression to confirm which metric and window produce the reported 'current: 2.0444444444444443' value, since the rule is absent from this Prometheus.
Advisory: review the deployment change record (change-history integration) for the checkout Deployment change applied around 2026-11-15T08:56:44Z.
